note: Master Review: a module attribute's VALUE is compile-time code. Before the fix the blanket isInAttribute gate silenced every call/instantiates edge inside it, so an Ash-style DSL section (`@section %Spark.Dsl.Section{... build: Spark.Dsl.build(...)}`) and a computed attribute (`@deferred fn -> Helper.later() end`, `@raised raise Helper.Error`) named no dependency at all: 21 attributes carrying 21 struct literals in a 250-file sample of ash, 0 elsewhere in 938 files. The DECLARATION attributes keep their silence (a typespec's %Duration{} is a TYPE reference, @behaviour/@derive are contracts, a docstring is text). EX-A18: multi-alias members that are lowercase identifiers produced zero dependency edges; measured 0 in the six corpora (latent hole, not a corpus defect). Call edges from inside a def carry the arity-qualified scope name (EX2-U2/W24 #17 convention, same as ex3-callsite-lines).
